This update was also given the name '''Hexscape Night II Update''', as this update added the [[The Nightmare Realm|second night]] of the [[Hexscape Event]]. This update encompassed nine updates, the main v1.38.0 update (released 25 October 2024) and eight minor updates, the v1.38.1 (released 25 October 2024), the v1.38.2 (released 25 October 2024), the v1.38.3 (released 25 October 2024), the v1.38.3a (released 26 October 2024), the v1.38.4 (released 29 October 2024), the v1.38.4a (released 29 October 2024), the v1.38.5 (released 30 October 2024) and not working. *Fixed [[VIP+]] giving players a 10% {{Money|Cash}} increase of the wave bonus. *Fixed the lobby tutorial. *Fixed [[Hidden Wave]] lighting. *Fixed [[Hidden Wave]] kick pop up not
